newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, OCTOBER 15 - THURSDAY, OCTOBER 24.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, OCTOBER 15 - THURSDAY, OCTOBER 24.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 15

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-298/94 Henke: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 1 of Council directive 77/187/EEC of February 14, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation relative to the maintenance of workers' rights in cases of the transfers of companies, operations or parts of operations. Notion of transfer. Transfer of administrative duties from a commune to an intra-communal administrative entity. Notion of conventional cessation. Convention of civil law bearing on the creation of a body responsible for administrative duties. - Judgment C-311/94 Ijssel-Vliet Combinatie: state aid. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 42 and 93, paragraph 1 of EC treaty, of regulation 4028/86 of December 18, 1986, on community actions for the improvement and adaptation of structures in the fishing and aquaculture sector and of Council directive 87/167/EEC of January 26, 1987, on aid for navel construction. Guidelines for the examination of national aid towards the building of fishing vessels. Commission competence to adopt such rules. Constraining effect on member states. - Opinion joined cases C-9/95, C-23/95 and C-156/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission regulation 2791/94 of November 16, 1994, on the exceptional attribution of an additional quantity to the tariff quota on banana imports for 1994, following hurricane Debbie. Inappropriate judicial basis. Temporary nature of article 30 of Council regulation 44/93 of February 13, 1993, on common organisation in the banana sector. Non-respect of quota distribution set down in article 19, paragraph 1 of regulation 404/93. - Opinion C-13/95 Suezen: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 77/187/EEC of February 14, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation relative to the maintenance of workers' rights in cases of the transfers of companies, operations or parts of operations. Field of application. Cancellation of a contract with an independent entrepreneur for clean work and conclusion of a contract with another independent entrepreneur. - Opinion joined cases C-71/95, C-155/95 and C-271/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission regulation 3304/94 of December 21, 1994, setting down temporary measures for banana imports to Austria, Finland and Sweden during the first quarter of 1995. - Oral procedure C-343/95 Diego Cali and Figli: competition. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 86 of EC treaty. Companies which member states empower to practice special or exclusive fees. Enterprise entrusted by the Genoa port authority with a service rendered in respect to pollution caused by vessels loading and unloading oil and petrochemical products. The offering of an unsolicited service paid according to a fixed tariff.
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 16

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0715 GMT) - Judgment joined cases T-336/94 Efisol v/ Commission: environment and consumers. Action for damages. Compensation, in conformity with articles 178 and 215, second line, of EC treaty, for damages caused by the refusal to grant import licences for chlorofluorocarbon 11 from Russia. Prior attribution of an import quota. Principle of legitimate confidence.
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-241/95 Accrington Beef: trade policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 1 and 2, paragraph 2 of Commission regulation 214/94 of January 31, 1994, laying down enforcement measures for Council regulation 130/90 as it relates to import policy on frozen bovine meat set out in code NC 0202 and products set out in code NC 0206 29 91. Tariff quota. Eligibility conditions for new operators. Minimum quantity of bovine meat exported towards third countries during the preceding year. Increase in relation to preceding rule. Possibility in cases of company merger to accumulate rights to obtain tariff quotas. Exclusion of new operators.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-283/94, C-291/94 and C-292/94 Devkavit International: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 3, paragraph 2 and 5 of Council directive 90/435/EEC of July 23, 1990, on common tax policy applicable to parent companies and their subsidiaries in different member states. Exemption from withholding tax of revenues channelled by a subsidiary towards its parent company. Faculty for member states to depart from this rule in cases where the parent company does not maintain for a minimum period a share interest giving it parent company status. Consequences of faulty transposition of the directive. - Judgment C-64/95 Lubella: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity and Interpretation of Commission regulation 1932/93 of July 16, 1993, setting down protective measures on certain sour cherry imports. Existence of formal conditions for a protective measure. Existence of material conditions justifying a protective measure. Retroactive effect of a rectification. - Judgment C-312/95 Commission v/ Luxembourg: environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directives 90/219/EEC of April 23, 1990, on the contained use of genetically modified micro-organisms and 90/220/EEC of April 23, 1990, on the deliberate release into the environment of genetically modified organisms. - Opinion C-139/95 Balestra: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1 to 5 of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters and of articles 1, 2 and 5 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principal of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Special policy in favour of workers in companies declared "in crisis" that, in affording the possibility of early retirement and accrued benefit for fictive periods, apply a different retirement age according to a worker's sex, taking into account the fact that the general policy allows only female workers to retire at 55 without attaining the normal retirement age for both sexes of 60. - Opinion C-298/95 Commission v/ Germany: environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to have transposed articles 3 and 5 of Council directive 78/659/EEC of July 18, 1978, on the quality of fresh waters needing protection or improvement in order to sustain fish life and of articles 3 and 5 of Council directive 79/923/EEC of October 30, 1979 on the quality required of shellfish waters.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-313/95 commission v/ Italy: agriculture. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/66/EEC of July 14, 1992, setting down community measures for the control of Newcastle disease and of Council directive 92/119/EEC of December 17, 1992, setting down general community measures against certain animal diseases as well as specific measures relating to swine vesicular disease.
